result.one_liner: Clay is a data enrichment and automation platform that provides API access for prospecting, data enhancement, and workflow automation with self-serve credentials.

evidence.quote: clay-api-key header for standard API requests
JWT Authentication for APIs with short-lived tokens
Under Account, locate API key. You'll find your API key here for integrations.
The Clay remote MCP server is a hosted Model Context Protocol endpoint at https://api.clay.com/v3/mcp
Users locate API keys directly in their Account settings, indicating self-serve access

result.notes: Clay provides multiple programmatic access methods: HTTP API with API key/JWT auth (undocumented endpoint count), official MCP server, and webhooks. API documentation is sparse (no OpenAPI spec or clear base URL), but self-serve credentials and official MCP integration make it buildable as an agent toolkit. Free tier access available.
